Merida chess pieces by Armando Hernandez Marroquin, GPLv2 or later.
Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/merida
Modified 2026-09-14: gradient fills replaced with flat white; dark outlines set to black to match the user reference. Piece shapes unchanged.
License: pieces/LICENSE.txt

Wood texture: Lichess/lila authors and pirouetti, AGPLv3 or later.
Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/master/public/images/board/wood.jpg
Texture file unchanged; warm color overlays applied via stylesheet.
License: BOARD-LICENSE.txt
Original upstream attribution: ATTRIBUTION.md

Classic chess pieces by Colin M.L. Burnett, GPLv2 or later.
Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece/cburnett
Files are unmodified; installed under pieces/classic.
License: pieces/LICENSE.txt

Maple board texture: Lichess/lila authors and pirouetti, AGPLv3 or later.
Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/463329af9a4b75cb1daeb046f4dba0d0ab375aea/public/images/board/maple.jpg
The unmodified Maple texture used by Lichess Mobile; installed as maple3.jpg.
License: BOARD-LICENSE.txt

Additional piece sets, downloaded unmodified from https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece on 2026-09-14:
Chessnut — Alexis Luengas, Apache 2.0. Source: public/piece/chessnut.
Fantasy, Celtic, Spatial — Maurizio Monge, MIT. Sources: public/piece/fantasy, public/piece/celtic, public/piece/spatial.
Pixel — therealqtpi and Lila contributors, AGPLv3 or later. Source: public/piece/pixel.
RhosGFX — RhosGFX, CC0 1.0. Source: public/piece/rhosgfx.
Each set includes its LICENSE.txt under assets/pieces/<set>/. SVG artwork is unmodified.

Nine more sets from https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/master/public/piece (2026-09-14):
Mono — Thibault Duplessis and Colin M.L. Burnett, GPLv2+. Modified: gray fill/stroke recolored for distinct white and black pieces; shapes unchanged.
Letter — usolando, AGPLv3+.
Pirouetti — pirouetti, AGPLv3+.
Shapes — flugsio, CC BY-SA 4.0. https://github.com/flugsio/chess_shapes
Kiwen Suwi — neverRare, CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/neverRare
Firi — James Faure, CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/jfaure/Firi-pieceset
MPChess — Maxime Chupin, GPLv3+. https://github.com/chupinmaxime
Totoy — Kosal Sen, CC BY 4.0.
Papercut — Nikolay Anzarov, CC BY 4.0. https://nikoichu.itch.io/
Individual source directories correspond to the assets/pieces/<set>/ directory names. Each includes LICENSE.txt. All SVGs except Mono are unmodified.

Optional move and capture sounds: unchanged Lichess Mobile Standard recordings,
GPLv3 or later. Source, authors, license and restoration details are in
audio/ATTRIBUTION.txt and tools/import-lichess-move-sound.py.
Optional haptics use the native iOS feedback generator.
